display.purpose: The typed value in the number input, centered, with tabular figures. Steps down to 1.75rem at 7 characters and 1.375rem at 10.

title.purpose: Habit names in the list (ink-2) and sheet titles (ink). One line with an ellipsis.

body.purpose: Dates in the day header (tabular, -0.01em), option labels (at 500), text fields (1.375rem line, never under 16px).

control.purpose: Buttons inside sheets and the toast action. The toast message uses the same size at 500.

description.purpose: The line under a sheet title, such as Today or Yesterday, in ink-3.

caption.purpose: The target or unit under the number field, in ink-3, up to two lines.

label.purpose: The weekday letter over each date in the day header.

shadows.name: elevation-light
shadows.purpose: Sheets, dialogs, popovers and the lifted row in the light theme, through var(--elevation).

shadows.name: elevation-dark
shadows.purpose: The same places in the dark theme: a hairline ring; the lighter surface is the elevation.

shadows.name: gauge-frame
shadows.value: inset 0 0 0 var(--ds-frame, 0.09375rem) color-mix(in oklch, var(--c) var(--frame-mix), transparent)
shadows.purpose: The frame of a zero or partial Day, in the habit color at 40% (light) or 35% (dark). Not depth.

shadows.name: gauge-frame-empty
shadows.purpose: The frame of an empty or future Day; var(--line-strong) under a fine pointer.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: The focus ring of a text field inside a sheet.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Every plain transition: presses, fades, the drain, the dialog and popover, the reorder.

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: The bottom sheet's exit and its scrim (400ms).

motion.name: spring-fill
motion.value: spring visualDuration 0.38s, bounce 0.24 (CSS: var(--spring-fill), a linear() easing)
motion.purpose: A Day gauge's fill when the value rises; retargets on fast taps.

motion.name: spring-sheet
motion.purpose: Sheets, dialogs and popovers that open, close and move; the habit page's month pager.

motion.name: spring-morph
motion.purpose: A sheet that changes its height between steps (MorphHeight).

motion.name: spring-pulse
motion.value: spring stiffness 600, damping 18, mass 1, start velocity 1.6
motion.purpose: The pulse of a square when its value rises: from scale 1 to about 1.04 and back.

motion.name: drain
motion.purpose: A Day gauge's fill when the value falls. No pulse.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Press feedback: Day and stepper 0.95, close and toast action 0.96, button 0.97, option 0.985, ghost row 0.99.

motion.name: color
motion.purpose: Color and background changes on hover and press.

motion.name: check
motion.purpose: The option check mark (fade and scale from 0.9) and the gauge frame color.

motion.name: pop
motion.purpose: A popover that enters or leaves (fade and scale from 0.96).

motion.name: dialog
motion.purpose: A dialog and its backdrop (fade and scale from 0.96); the reorder of rows.

motion.name: hold
motion.purpose: A held number square shrinks to 0.9 over the long-press time, as progress toward the input.

motion.name: touch-press-delay
motion.purpose: On touch, the pressed look waits so a scroll that starts on a square does not dip it.

motion.name: skeleton
motion.purpose: The list skeleton never flashes on a fast start.

motion.name: close-after-pick
motion.purpose: A choice or scale sheet stays open after a pick so the check is seen.

motion.name: reduced-motion-fade
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion a fade replaces each movement; a swipe still follows the finger.

narrative.overview:
The app is a bare ground with only data on it. In the light theme the ground is white. In the dark theme it is pure black. There are no cards, no panels and no dividers: space separates the rows. The only hue on the screen is the habit's own color, in its icon and in its Day gauges.

Each Day is a gauge: a squircle that fills from the bottom. An empty Day is a frame. A full Day is solid. This one shape carries the product, in the list, on the habit page and inside the inputs. The type is one family, IBM Plex Sans, in a small set of sizes. Hierarchy comes from weight and from four steps of ink.

The care goes into motion and touch, not into decoration. A value that rises springs up, and the square pulses to about 1.04. A value that falls drains without a bounce. On a phone, forms open as bottom sheets. On a desktop, they open as dialogs and popovers. The theme follows the system setting, and there is no switch. The desktop is the phone layout in a 600px column with a 20px base.
keyCharacteristics: A bare ground: white or pure black, with no surfaces at rest.
Color only where it is data: the habit icon and the Day gauges.
The Day gauge (DaySquare) is the one signature shape.
Squircle corners everywhere, with a plain radius as the fallback.
One typeface, IBM Plex Sans, in sizes from 12px to 17px plus one large number size.
Springs that settle quickly, a short overshoot when a value rises, and fades under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Data-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Habit hue appears only on what belongs to a habit: its icon, its Day gauges, and the ring of the Day under edit. Text, controls, focus rings and overlays use ink and surface tones. The one exception is shadcn's `destructive`, which borrows rose.

rules.name: The One Hue, Two Lightnesses Rule
rules.body: A habit color keeps its hue and chroma in both themes. Only the lightness moves: darker on white for contrast, the owner's values on black.

rules.name: The Four Inks Rule
rules.body: Text uses `ink`, `ink-2`, `ink-3` and `ink-4`, from strongest to quietest. Do not add a fifth grey for text.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Sans is the only typeface. Hierarchy comes from weight (400, 500, 600, 700) and from the ink step, not from a second family or a large jump in size.

rules.name: The Today Is Bold Rule
rules.body: Weight 700 marks today and nothing else.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: A number that sits in a column or changes in place (the dates in the header, the stepper, the number field) uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Flat Ground Rule
rules.body: Nothing that sits on the ground has a drop shadow. A shadow means "this is above the page": an overlay, or a row in the hand.

rules.name: The Lighter Is Higher Rule
rules.body: In the dark theme, elevation is a lighter surface, not a shadow.

rules.name: The Squircle Rule
rules.body: No rounded corner without `corner-shape: squircle` and the 1.75 multiplier where it is supported. A hard-coded radius alone looks too tight in a browser that draws superellipses.

rules.name: The Dashed Means Not Yet Rule
rules.body: A dashed outline means "this does not exist yet", as in the ghost "New habit" row. Nothing else is dashed.

rules.name: The Rise Pulses Rule
rules.body: A value that rises springs up and pulses to about 1.04. A value that falls drains in 200ms with no bounce.

rules.name: The One Grammar Rule
rules.body: Every screen uses the springs and durations in `components/motion.ts`. A new screen does not invent its own curve.

dos: Do put a habit's color in scope with `habitColorStyle(color)` (`--c`) and draw from it: the gauge, the icon, `text-habit`, `bg-habit`, `border-habit`.

Do use `DaySquare` for every Day on every screen, in your own button with a touch target of about 44px. Set `animated={false}` for a large static grid and a thinner `--ds-frame` (0.0625rem) for a small square.
Do round every corner with `corner-shape: squircle` and the 1.75 multiplier: the `squircle-*` utility, or `calc(<radius> * var(--squircle-k))`.
Do write measures in rem, so the desktop's 20px base scales them, and keep the content in the 600px column.
Do set text in the four inks: `ink` for primary text, `ink-2` for habit names, `ink-3` for secondary text and the day header, `ink-4` for the ghost row and disabled controls.
Do open every form and input with `ResponsiveSheet`: a bottom sheet on a phone, a dialog or a popover at 640px and more.
Do give every movement a reduced-motion fade of 180ms, and keep a swipe under the finger.
Do use tabular figures for dates, steppers and number fields.
Do check both themes: light is the default, dark comes from `prefers-color-scheme`.
donts: Don't put a habit on a card, a panel or a tile, and don't separate rows with lines or dividers. Space separates them.
Don't use habit color for names, UI text, buttons, focus rings or overlays. It stays on the icon and the gauge.
Don't give anything that sits on the ground a drop shadow, the toast included. Shadows are for overlays and the lifted row.
Don't show a Day's state by color alone: an empty Day is a frame, a filled Day has a fill.
Don't pulse or bounce on a fall. A drain is 200ms with `--ease-out`.
Don't hard-code a radius without the squircle multiplier.
Don't add a second typeface, uppercase eyebrows or kickers, or letter-spaced labels.
Don't set the text of a field under 16px.
Don't style a quit habit differently from a build habit, and don't draw streaks, percentages or badges.
Don't add a theme switch or a `.dark` class; the theme is the system setting.
